task.objective: Deliver 40 town crop cargos to markets while negotiating physical permits, river access, irrigation and delayed flood protection before H=1024.
task.natural_termination: Natural completion at 40 cumulative market deliveries; otherwise horizon truncation at 1024.
task.interaction: Two distinct local contributors within four ticks and a civic witness create a carried permit. Permits compete between gate access and water allocation. Upstream levees redirect a later flood pulse into downstream towns. Open sluices aid access and irrigation but admit floodwater. Ferries, roads and markets alter future cargo choices.
task.observation_access: Only own prefix and radius-two Chebyshev 5x5 patch with exact listed channels enter the policy. Visible actor identity, role, crew, tools, cargo, stamina and message are in the patch. Each object attribute is in its group channels. Hidden cells and entities remain hidden; global debugger must be labeled. Clock alone is public.
